{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp to fix an unintended copy of PrecomputedTransactionData in btck_script_pubkey_verify().",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Fixes an unintended copy of caller txdata on every verification call in the C API, delivering substantial performance improvements. Reviewer fametrano reported that eliminating the ternary-forced copy yielded an orders-of-magnitude speedup on the kernel API benchmark."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/validation.cpp relate strictly to ConnectBlock and script cache lookups, with no changes to transaction policy, acceptance, or mempool structures.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not touch mempool rules or policy logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates to unit tests, fuzz harnesses, and verify_script benchmark are mechanical adaptations to the new PrecomputedTransactionData constructor.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits in src/test/ and src/bench/ follow mechanically from removing the default constructor and do not alter test infrastructure or test framework behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled Consensus and modifies PrecomputedTransactionData lifecycle in src/script/interpreter.{h,cpp} and block connection in src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Enforces constructor initialization for PrecomputedTransactionData, eliminating latent hazards around partial sighash reinitialization. It also avoids allocating unused txdata storage during ConnectBlock when assumevalid skips script verification, but does not alter validation consensus rules or fix an active consensus bug."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/wallet/feebumper.cpp and src/psbt.cpp are one-line mechanical constructor updates following the API change.",

      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not substantively touch wallet logic or interfaces."
    }
  ],
